reviews.title: Good input and output quality
reviews.comment: Have had this for over a year and it's been great! I use it both as a mic and plug my headphones into the audio jack. Great input and output quality. Had a different blue yeti previously that lasted about 8 years before subtle constant clicking sounds could be heard through the mic and eventually something in the circuit board went and it died
reviews.author: Jack Smith

reviews.title: Great Mic - Sensitive Cord
reviews.comment: The mic works wonderfully and I am told it sounds nice, however, anytime I slightly bump the cord on the back my mic cuts out completely and stays that way for a little. This could be an error on my end, but I have no idea how to fix it. Just be warned!
